description: Read all appearance and behaviour settings for one website's chat widget: colours, greeting, position, auto-trigger, data collection, bookings and the rest. Also returns which settings this account's plan cannot change, and the plan each of those needs.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: get_widget_settings
title: Get the chat widget settings
